principles: inventory count is one resumable session, not a collection of row-save forms
line updates remain optimistic-version fenced and auditable
dirty rows autosave after a bounded debounce and on blur
saving a row never rerenders the full count workspace while the operator is typing
finalize first flushes dirty rows and stops if any row failed to save
blank count quantities are not silently converted to zero by autosave
save failures stay visible and retryable
